svg.aria-label: Left: as w grows the fraction of samples in the right class reaches 100 percent while the split between the two blobs of the class collapses and samples start to leave the data. Right: Frechet distance to the real class is lowest at w = 1 for an exact model but at a larger w for a model that under-uses the label
